A '''listening post''' was operated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in the [[Syvris system/Legends|Syvris system]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]].

==History==
By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="3643BBY" /> the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]], the primary [[Spy/Legends|intelligence]] agency of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Sith Wars/Legends|Sith Wars]],<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Strategic Information Service}}</ref> operated a [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] in the the [[Syvris system/Legends|Syvris system]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the listening station was discovered by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces who accused the installation of violating the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] and deployed naval forces to seize and destroy intelligence stored there. While SIS personnel stationed at the facility initiated an evacuation, the Empire pressed its attack and the SIS sustained some casualties. The recently formed attack [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] [[Coruscant Aegis]] rallied in the system to defend the evacuation. In the ensuing [[Battle of the Syvris system|battle]], the squadron defended fleeing SIS personnel preserving the gathered intelligence from attacking Imperial forces.<ref name="SE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The SIS listening post in the Syvris system was mentioned for a space combat mission for all four Republic player character classes in the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[2011]].<ref name="SE" />
